title: Scaled dot-product attention
subtitle: How a query decides which values to read

idea.what: Each query q is compared with every key k by a dot product. The scores are divided by √dk and turned into weights with softmax. The output is the weighted average of the value rows.
idea.why: This is the core operation of the Transformer.

playground_intro: Edit the matrices or switch scaling off and watch the weights change.
